name: phishguard
description: PhishGuard - Machine Learning Phishing URL Detector

scripts.predict: node -e "const { spawn } = require('child_process'); const p = process.platform === 'win32' ? 'venv\\Scripts\\python.exe' : 'venv/bin/python'; spawn(p, ['src/predict.py', ...process.argv.slice(1)], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true });"
scripts.train: node -e "const { spawn } = require('child_process'); const p = process.platform === 'win32' ? 'venv\\Scripts\\python.exe' : 'venv/bin/python'; spawn(p, ['src/train.py'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true });"
scripts.evaluate: node -e "const { spawn } = require('child_process'); const p = process.platform === 'win32' ? 'venv\\Scripts\\python.exe' : 'venv/bin/python'; spawn(p, ['src/evaluate.py'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true });"
